name: 49333 · Middleville, MI
findings: ZIP 49333 (Middleville) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49333 (Middleville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
